handoffs.message: Helper-claimed by idle Codex2; previous owner Antigravity becomes reviewer.

PR #3961 is ready for independent review. Anchor e4659a65a and delivery 9e5004065 implement fail-closed triage tooling, 19 tests, operations contract, and a validated 29-PR/2091-branch report at dev SHA 9a24478e. Dispositions: 11 active-repair, 8 conflict-needs-owner, 4 protected-retain, 5 superseded, 1 merged-reachable. Explicit evidence closures #3058/#3317/#3334/#3372 are live CLOSED with recorded comments; all four remote branches remain; deletion dry run has 0 candidates and no deletion code. Branch updated by normal merge to ce1fe3bd0; no force push.
Auto-reassigned OPS-TASK-PR-TRIAGE-001 away from unavailable lane Antigravity (disabled, paused, sidecar-only, or auth-down); reviewer Antigravity -> Codex.

Reviewer changes required: (1) fix snapshot binding so --refresh completes before base_sha capture and every ancestry decision is computed against that immutable base SHA; regenerate report/README/manifest and add validation/regression coverage. The committed report mislabels 1,643/2,091 branch rows versus its own beef87e0 base (for example AG-BE-CP-001 head 2b29d871 is an ancestor but reported false), while validate still passes. (2) update the published fixed-cohort reproduce command to include task-closed PRs #3058/#3317/#3334/#3372 as well as #3936/#3948; the documented command now fails with expected 29, found 25. Re-run unit tests, py_compile, report validation, immutable-SHA ancestry reconciliation, and git diff --check before handoff.

Reviewer fixes are merged in Pantheon PR #3970 (merge 0ad37f1db8a48bf1601966cc4da67cd0f8e157fc; task commit 60bb954df0117c82668053f7ac236985277a8ecd) and ready for re-review. Revalidated 22/22 unittest cases, py_compile, committed evidence validation at immutable base ea1a8607 (29 PRs/2096 branches/1148 deletion dry-run candidates), and git diff --check. Fresh documented reproduction after --refresh bound report base exactly to origin/dev 6487e0699bb9fdc92cbace38f54ee4ac2d39ce4d, retained all six resolved cohort PRs #3058/#3317/#3334/#3372/#3936/#3948, and passed full ancestry validation for 29 PRs/2098 branches with the same 1148 dry-run candidates. No branch deletion or additional GitHub mutation was performed.

Reviewer changes required after fresh documented reproduction: prior immutable-SHA ancestry and six resolved fixed-cohort fixes are verified, but render_markdown mislabels summary.open_task_pr_count (all currently open task PRs) as the fixed cohort open count. At base 1065a024be51142d26ebce69024dd7217d66a607, validation passes 29 PRs/2098 branches/1148 dry-run candidates, while the cohort is 23 OPEN + 6 resolved; README incorrectly says 24 open + 6 resolved because recent non-cohort PR #3975 is counted. Add explicit cohort open/resolved counts derived from cohort, render those (keep any global open count separately and clearly labeled), add a regression with a recent open task PR excluded from the overdue cohort, regenerate evidence, and rerun unittest, py_compile, full ancestry validation, fresh documented reproduction, and git diff --check. No branch deletion or GitHub mutation is needed.

PR #3982 is ready for independent re-review. Commits dcec9a10e/cc3c0186d separate fixed-cohort counts (29 = 23 open + 6 resolved) from 25 global open task PRs, add recent-non-cohort regression and summary invariants, normalize as_of before age calculations, and regenerate evidence at immutable dev fb2df8ec (2098 branches; 1148 dry-run candidates; 0 new closure candidates). Verified 24/24 unittest, py_compile, full ancestry validation, byte-identical same-snapshot reproduction, four prior closure/head live readbacks, retained remote branches, zero branch deletions, and git diff --check.

Independent review approved: PR #3982 is merged at 60f3e9b7; 24/24 tests, py_compile, immutable/full ancestry validation, live regeneration, closure/replacement/retained-head readbacks, and zero-deletion safety checks passed. Returned to Codex2 for formal closeout.
